content.text:
Keyboard keys press the same on-screen buttons, so they follow the same rules, including the error lock. `key-sci` opens a panel with √x, x² and 1/x; each shows its result at once, and a non-finite result is an Error. I only moved the existing click handling into one shared function, the script passes a syntax check, and I found no earlier checks to run and did not test it in a browser.
I let `key-sci` work during an Error, since it changes no numbers. `Enter` and `/` skip their browser defaults so they can't click a focused button twice or open find.
I rejected keyboard shortcuts for the scientific keys (not asked for) and closing the panel on AC.
